result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_edge_creation_order()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get edges in their creation order. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L3223-L3278){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_edge_creation_order() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Returns edge IDs ordered by when they were added to the graph. The first edge created appears first, the most recently created edge appears last. Useful for temporal analysis or understanding edge addition patterns. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Edge IDs in chronological creation order. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Like node IDs, edge IDs are already returned in creation order elsewhere, but this method makes that ordering explicit and guaranteed: ::: {#d2b48d2a .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="C") .add_edge(source="C", target="A") ) creation_order = graph.get_edge_creation_order() len(creation_order) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 3 ``` ::: ::: Combined with `get_node_ids_by_edge_id()`, the order reveals which nodes each edge connected, in the sequence they were added: ::: {#0bc4eb38 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} [graph.get_node_ids_by_edge_id(eid) for eid in creation_order] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` [(1, 2), (2, 3), (3, 1)] ``` ::: ::: This is useful for selecting edges by when they were added -- for example, isolating the earliest edges in a large graph: ::: {#26bccfb2 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ec.Graph().add_path_graph(20) early_edges = graph.get_edge_creation_order()[:10] graph.select_edges_by_id(early_edges) graph.get_selected_edge_ids() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` [7, 3, 10, 6, 2, 9, 5, 1, 8, 4] ``` ::: :::
